item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Hasina accepted free and fair elections as a genuine route to losing power.\nI also did not find strong counterevidence showing she voluntarily constrained herself to truly competitive electoral rules in practice.\nThe best-supported conclusion is that elections were held, but not on terms that made power meaningfully contestable.","evidence":[{"title":"Fear of violence looms over a contentious Bangladesh election as polls open","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"January 6-7, 2024","url":"https://ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/ap-top-news/2024/01/06/fear-of-violence-looms-over-a-contentious-bangladesh-election-as-polls-open/","summary":"AP reported Hasina’s Awami League won a strong majority while the main opposition boycotted the vote, turnout was about 40%, and legitimacy doubts were widespread; this is direct evidence against meaningful electoral contestability.","question_ids":["4B.1","2B.4","2B.5","2B.10"]},{"title":"The US and UK say Bangladesh's elections extending Hasina's rule were not credible","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"January 8, 2024","url":"https://ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/ap-top-news/2024/01/09/the-us-and-uk-say-bangladeshs-elections-extending-hasinas-rule-were-not-credible","summary":"AP reported that key foreign partners viewed the election as not credible, reinforcing that Hasina did not leave power contestable through a fair electoral process.","question_ids":["4B.1","2B.4","2B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh repression, security force abuses discredit elections","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism and widespread repression before the January election, showing that dissent and competition were being chilled rather than allowed to determine power.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","2B.4","2B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s crackdown on protesters left more than 170 dead, U.N. says","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people had been killed and warned that internet shutdowns increase impunity; that is consistent with a ruler relying on coercion rather than accepting contestable power.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.5","3B.6","3B.9","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence; this looks like coercive blame-shifting rather than acceptance of electoral contestability.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.3","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","2B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described internet/text shutdowns, curfew, and army deployment as the government escalated against protesters, which is incompatible with genuine acceptance that power should be contestable through meaningful elections.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","2B.4"]}]}
